journeyCount.description: Journeys the viewer may see: all of your own, the public ones of anyone else

followsYou.description: True when this person follows the viewer

hasBlocked.description: True when the viewer has blocked this person

notifyNewEntries.description: New entries in journeys you follow, grouped per journey

digestEmail.description: Also send the weekly digest by email

reminders.description: Gentle reminders to add an entry, at most one a day. Off until the person asks for them.

reminderHour.description: The hour of the person's own day, 0 to 23, at which reminders arrive. 19 is 7 pm, and what is used when this is left out.

removeAvatar.description: True to go back to no picture

ageConfirmed.description: The person confirms they are 13 or older. Needed, and must be true, when the profile is first created.

token.description: The device's address at the push service, as Expo gives it

timeZone.description: Where the device is, such as Europe/Berlin, so reminders arrive at the right hour. UTC when left out or unknown.

authorizationCode.description: The one-time authorization code Apple gives the app at sign-in

coverThumbUrl.description: A smaller version of the cover, for cards and lists

latestNumber.description: Day or part number of the latest entry; 0 before the first one

progressLabel.description: Ready to show: "Day 14", "Day 12 of 30", "Part 5" or "Not started"

shareUrl.description: The web page to share: it opens for anyone, with or without the app. Null for a private journey.

authors.description: Everyone who writes in this journey: the owner first, then the friends who joined. More than one means it is shared.

pausedAutomatically.description: True when the journey paused by itself after 30 days without an entry, not because its owner paused it

isMember.description: True when the viewer is a friend who joined this shared journey

lastReadAt.description: When the viewer last read this journey. Entries created after it are new to them. Null unless they follow it.

lat.description: Where the place is on the map. Send both numbers or neither.

locationPrecision.description: city (the default when there is a point) or exact. Other people see a city-level point unless it is exact.

clientId.description: An id the app makes up for this draft. Sending the same draft again gives back the entry it made the first time.

position.description: Its place in the story, counting from 1

lat.description: Where it is on the map. Other people get a city-level point unless the author chose the exact spot.

status.description: ready, or for a clip that its author still sees: processing (being converted) or failed. Other people only ever get ready ones.

url.description: A picture to show: the photo itself, or a clip's still frame

thumbUrl.description: A smaller version of that picture, for lists and grids

playbackUrl.description: For a clip that is ready: the address to play it from. Null for photos.

held.description: True while the automatic check has this photo held for a reviewer. Only its owner ever sees a held photo.

durationSeconds.description: For a clip: how long it is, in whole seconds. At most 60.

mediaId.description: Use this id when saving the entry, journey or profile

clientId.description: An id the app makes up for this draft. Sending the same draft again gives back the journey it made the first time.

since.description: When they were invited or, once joined, when they joined

spotsLeft.description: How many more friends can be invited

url.description: The link to send. It is shown once: only a hash of it is kept.

parentId.description: The comment being replied to, if any

clientId.description: An id the app makes up for this comment. Sending it again gives back the comment it made the first time.

parentId.description: The comment this one replies to. Replies are one level deep.

byCreator.description: True when the journey's creator wrote it

held.description: True while the comment waits for a reviewer. Only its author ever sees a held comment.

clearCover.description: True to go back to using the first photo as the cover

status.description: active or paused. Completing a journey has its own step.

latestJourney.description: The title of their newest public journey

journeys.description: The best matches, most followed first; at most 30

people.description: The best matches, most followed first; at most 30

nextCursor.description: Send this back as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.
Send this back as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

profile.description: Null until the person has created their profile

url.description: A web page anyone can open, with or without the app

text.description: A line to send along with the link

nextCursor.description: Send this back as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.
Send this back as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

first.description: The first entry of the story

latest.description: The newest three entries, newest first

days.description: The day numbers that have an entry, for a challenge's row of ticks

newCount.description: Entries by others since the viewer last read the journey; 0 when they don't follow it

firstNewEntryId.description: Where to start reading: the first of the new entries

pins.description: The entries that have a place, in story order

pinCount.description: How many entries have a place; more than the pins when the map is capped

placeCount.description: How many different places they are in

capped.description: True when the journey has more places than a map shows at once

thumbUrl.description: A small picture of the entry's first photo

nextCursor.description: Send as `cursor` for the entries after these. Null at the end of the story.

prevCursor.description: Send as `cursor` for the entries before these. Null at the start of the story.

total.description: How many entries the story has

dayCount.description: From the start date to the last entry, counting both

momentUrls.description: Photos of the best moments: milestones first, then the most liked

nextCursor.description: Send this back as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

newCount.description: How many entries are new to the reader

entries.description: The newest of them, newest first; at most three

followingCount.description: How many journeys the reader follows, for the empty state

nextCursor.description: Send as `cursor` for more journeys with news. Null when there are no more.
Send this back as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

latest.description: The newest of the week's entries

entryCount.description: How many entries the week brought, across all followed journeys

moment.description: The most liked entry of the week

finished.description: Followed journeys that were completed this week

clips.description: Whether short clips can be added to entries. False until the video service is connected.

id.description: Stable for the same line, so the app can keep its place in a list

isNew.description: True when it happened after the person last opened Activity

actors.description: Who did it, most recent first; at most two

actorCount.description: How many people did it, for "and 46 others"

entryTitle.description: The entry's title, or the start of its text

text.description: The words of a comment or reply

followsActor.description: For profile_follow: true when the person already follows them back

unseen.description: True when something happened since the person last opened Activity
